_about: The ONE channel this skill makes videos for. Every new project, lint, QA and upload pack reads this file. Edit it when the channel changes.
name: Scene Samjho
bio: 🎬 Trailer, gaane, box office: DECODE in Hindi | 🔍 Har scene ka asli matlab | 🕐 Roz 2 reels: 1 PM & 7:30 PM
language: Hindi voice-over (Devanagari for TTS), Roman Hinglish on-screen captions
niche: Bollywood + OTT DECODE in Hindi: trailers, songs, box office, OTT releases, film facts — har scene ka asli matlab
audience: Hindi-speaking movie fans in India, 16–35, mostly on phones, sound often off

pillars.decode: Trailer / song / teaser decoded scene by scene: clues about the film's story
pillars.numbers: Box office, budget, advance booking, records: one big number per reel
pillars.facts: N things nobody knows about a film / star / release
pillars.this_week: What to watch this week: theatre + OTT, with a one-line verdict each
pillars.theory: Fan theories or a debate with a two-option question

trend_override: If a big trailer / teaser / song / release / box-office headline broke in the last 24 h, skip the day's pillar and decode that instead, posted the same day.

posts.what: Time-sensitive topic (release tomorrow, trailer just out, box-office headline): more hours to spread before it gets old
Prime time: the day's pillar or the strongest topic

schedule.slot_rule: Two different topics a day, never two reels on the same film the same day. Both scripts go to the operator in the morning; each is rendered only after 'continue'.

stories.what: Poll / quiz about today's two topics (e.g. 'Aaj Ramayana ya Eetha?')
Share reel 1 to Story with a 'NEW REEL' sticker
Optional 4th: poll result / question box / tomorrow's teaser

day_plan.what: Research both topics (last 24–48 h) + morning Story
Make reel 1 (proof → make → QA → deliver); script MD for reel 2
Reel 1 live · reply to comments till 14:00
Reel 2 live · reply to comments till 20:30
`run.py log` with 24 h Insights numbers for both reels

reel_rules.engagement_rule: Script Doctor v4: exactly ONE explicit CTA = the two-option comment question, shown on screen over the last beat (cta_loop data.question) + caption + pinned comment; the voice ends on the loop line; one send-worthy line names a kind of person ('wo dost jo…'); never 'share / like / follow / save karo'.
reel_rules.length_test: From 4 Nov 2026: make reels 25–40 s (target 35) for the next 6 reels, then compare avg watch % and skip rate with the 49 s Ramayan reel in the Tuesday review.
hook_rules: Frame 1 already shows the whole hook text (3–6 big words) on a face close-up. No build-up from an empty or one-word frame: 82.7 % of views come from the Reels tab, where people judge the first frame, not the cover.
The payoff of the hook lands by 2 s. No set-up sentence first.
The send line comes before ~70 % of the reel, not only at the end: in the Ramayan reel only ~3 % were left at the end.
reel_rules.share_topics: Pick topics people send to a friend: a meme they already share (e.g. Drishyam '2 October'), a debate with two sides, a detail most people missed, nostalgia with a fresh number. Plain news recaps and topics every page already covered rarely get sends.
voice_style: Talk like a person to a friend, not a narrator: 'bhai', 'aap/tum', 'kasam se', 'believe nahi hoga', 'maine dekha'. No greeting, no 'dosto'.
First words = the claim + the number or name, said within 2 s ('Terah sau crore ke Prabhas').
One fact or number per sentence; numbers early.
Compare with something the audience already knows (Baahubali, RRR, KGF, a meme).
Ride the week's trending debate into your topic ('Sab X ki baat kar rahe hain… lekin kya aapko pata hai…').
Reviews: verdict in the first sentence, then the reasons, then one personal pick ('mujhe personally…').
Hold a curiosity gap: name the film or the answer late, or count down 3 → 1.
End on a callback to the hook or a clear verdict ('isko miss mat karna'), then the two-option question on screen. Never 'like / share / follow karo'.
Pace: 3.3–4 words/s for fact lists; slower with pauses only to build suspense.
visual_style: Footage is the picture: bright, full-colour, a new shot every 0.8–2 s.
On-screen text only for the number or name that matters (data.tag), or a series label. No full sentences on screen except the frame-1 hook and the final question.
Rotate or band 16:9 trailer footage instead of cropping away 70 % of it (fit 'rotate' / split look).
Never the same look as the last reel (DNA look rotation: poster / clean / rush / bar / split).
Best upgrade: the operator on camera (assets.host). All 5 reference creators show their face.

workflow: 1. `python run.py channel` — brief: today's pillar, both reel slots, stories, recent topics (never repeat one).
2. Topic → prompts/1-research-brief.md → <project>/pack/research-brief_<slug>.md (web research, sources with dates).
3. prompts/2-script-doctor.md (v4): Draft-0 from the brief → score → flaws → 3 angles, 3 hooks, 2 drafts → swipe test → re-audit → <project>/pack/script-pack_<slug>.md.
4. Beats into project.json (say = Devanagari, show = Roman, same word count; slot; post_date) → lint → voice → proof → look at frames, fix layout.
5. `python run.py handover <project>` (prompts/3-pdf-handover-builder.md adapted) → open every page PNG → fix → send the PDF. STOP: wait for 'continue'.
6. After 'continue': make → QA PASS + review.md → deliver → send mp4, _no_music.mp4, cover, upload pack.
7. `run.py log <project> --status made`; after posting/24 h: `--status posted` + Insights numbers. Commit + push channel/.
never: Raw movie clips or someone else's reel re-posted as is (Instagram originality policy)
Reels longer than 90 s for discovery (3 min+ reels are not pushed to non-followers)
Facts without a source; fan theories without the word 'theory'
A greeting as the first line; a reel without a cover; more than 5 hashtags
Committing copyrighted stills or the final videos to this repo

lessons.numbers: 158 views, skip 62.7 %, avg watch 7 s of 49 s, 0 shares, 0 follows (at 2 h)
lessons.lesson: Hook frame and topic, not length alone: half the viewers left in the first second. Next reels: hook text on frame 1, payoff by 2 s, 25–40 s, a share-able topic, send line earlier.

lessons.numbers: 481 views, skip 52.6 %, avg watch 5 s of 39 s, 2 likes, 0 shares, 0 follows (at ~4 h)
lessons.lesson: Frame-1 hook worked (skip 62.7 → 52.6 %, 3x views) but viewers left right after it. Reference analysis (docs/REFERENCE_ANALYSIS.md): top creators show a real person, bright footage, almost no text, a different layout from ours. Skill now rotates looks and supports the operator's face-cam.

_about_defaults: No DNA dims pinned here on purpose: pinning caption_style/motif made every reel look the same. Voice +28 %: the 5 reference creators speak 3.3–4.2 words/s; our +18 % voice was 2.7 words/s.
_reference_analysis: docs/REFERENCE_ANALYSIS.md (5 top Hindi film shorts, 4 Nov 2026)

host.name: Scene Samjho host (the operator)
host.source: Photo sent by the operator in chat on 4 Nov 2026 as his own photo, to appear in every video.
host.where: hook (frame 1, under the hook text), every footage_clean scene (bottom, waist-up), the lower panel of split scenes, host_cam beats, and the cover
host.limits: A still photo: it lifts on every spoken word but the mouth does not move. For a real talking look, record a selfie video (assets.host).
